book_info.title: Luna and the Moonbeam
book_info.subtitle: A Bedtime Adventure
book_info.moral: The magic of nighttime and peaceful sleep

art_style.lighting: soft moonlit glow, warm bedroom light

luna.name: Luna
luna.description: A sweet little girl with long wavy dark brown hair, big round hazel eyes with long eyelashes, rosy cheeks, and a gentle smile. She has light olive skin.

clothing.pajamas: soft lavender pajamas with tiny silver stars, bare feet
clothing.accessories: a small stuffed bunny named Mr. Hops that she carries everywhere

luna.pose_notes: Often shown yawning, rubbing eyes, or gazing up in wonder

moonbeam.name: Moonbeam
moonbeam.description: A small, friendly glowing orb of soft golden-silver light with a gentle face (two kind eyes and a warm smile visible in the glow). About the size of a tennis ball. Leaves a trail of sparkles when moving.

mr_hops.name: Mr. Hops
mr_hops.description: A well-loved cream-colored stuffed bunny with floppy ears, a pink nose, and button eyes. Slightly worn and soft from years of cuddles.

settings.lunas_bedroom: A cozy bedroom with pale pink walls, a white wooden bed with a lavender quilt covered in moon and star patterns, a window showing the night sky, fairy lights strung above the bed, and soft toys on shelves
settings.dream_clouds: Fluffy, soft clouds in shades of lavender and silver, with stars twinkling around them
settings.starlit_sky: Deep midnight blue sky filled with twinkling stars and a large, friendly crescent moon
